runtimeAssessment.reason: Four sampled viewport cells fail because native clave_catastro is null on returned polygons. Among the 376 successfully retained cadastral references, independent EPSG:32614 GEOS finds 270 exact duplicate geometry pairs and 309 overlap pairs above 0.01 m². A fresh original EPSG:6369 request reproduces identical 237.533623 m² footprints for two different native cadastral keys. Both rows have distinct publisher idpredio UUIDs and tipo=2, forma=null; no inspected publisher rule defines an authoritative ground-only/lifecycle exclusion. Replacing native identity does not resolve overlapping record geometry. No repair, invented identifier or selective exclusion is applied. This source remains held on native-key completeness and ground-geometry semantics.
